meta.title: Clicking after the user lost access to the PR

steps.note: Enable the required PR team-filtering configuration for the case.

args.goal: Log in as User A, click the top-right bell icon, open the notification for PR-1, and verify the resulting screen shows a no-access or not-found message for PR-1 rather than any PR-1 data.

steps.note: Perform and observe the notification click flow, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Verify that handling the inaccessible PR notification does not leave a crash, server error, raw data, or broken page.
